title: Expose current kiosk tokens in authenticated Admin settings

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Admin display-client settings tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/serving_control/test_display_client_admin.py

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done.

evidence_required: display-client-access.md#admin-settings-token-read RED: GET /staff/display-clients is absent; GREEN: the same-origin page lists each kiosk id/name/spa_id/active/current full token on every active operator/developer read, returns the same value after reload and database restart, returns 403 to photographer and no token with 401 for invalid staff auth, adds Cache-Control no-store and leaks no credential into URL, application/proxy log, analytics or command output; decisive comparison: role/session/reload/restart fixtures and redaction scans inspect response/body/headers/logs; artifact: focused pytest and captures under .tasks/TASK-058-T3-FT-003-W2/.
purpose: Implement the owner-authorized Admin read surface independently of kiosk-side manual configuration.
success_outcome: Authorized operator/developer can always retrieve the current token for each named kiosk without rotation or leakage; all other principals cannot.
anti_goals: Do not copy/push/store the token in any kiosk.
Do not reset/regenerate a token merely to display it.
Do not modify staff roles/sessions or introduce a generic settings framework.

forbidden_scope: Kiosk profile handoff owned by TASK-059-T3-FT-003-W3
Credential mutation lifecycle owned by TASK-041-T3-FT-003-W1
stop_conditions: Existing staff principal cannot support the exact role matrix.
The page cannot stay no-store and redacted.
A token read would require rotation or one-time display semantics.

constraints: Use the existing same-origin staff session and active operator/developer roles.
Read token_value only through serving_control owner authorization.
Use disposable kiosk/staff fixtures and retain redacted output.
invariants: Current token is visible on every authorized read and survives reload/restart.
Photographer and invalid staff auth receive no token.
Response is no-store and token never enters URLs/logs/analytics/command artifacts.
verification_targets: Repeated authorized read plus database-restart persistence.
